newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ALL EMEX BIDDERS TO CONTINUE NEGOTATIONS.
newsitem.headline: ALL EMEX BIDDERS TO CONTINUE NEGOTATIONS.

text.p: The Estonian privatisation agency on Wednesday decided to continue negotiations with the six companies competing to buy a 51 percent in the Estonian Metal Export (EMEX) company.
"The competition will continue as no bids were substantially stronger than any other," the spokesperson of the agency told Reuters.
The first round of negotiated bids closed on May 8 and six companies were selected.
The six companies were: Germany's HKS GmbH Handelsegellschaft, Estonia's Neotrust OU, Amalard As, Transkorp OU, Nelimet As, and Finland's Kuusakoski OY.
EMEX has a monopoly on scrap metal exports and imports in Estonia.
